title: Landing-page corrections: logo reliability, spacing, screenshots fit, Our Story expand/collapse, accordion polish, footer contact

requirements.summary: Ensure landing header/footer brand logo never shows as broken and stays aligned across viewports with a text fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Landing page header and footer, the logo loads correctly (no broken image icon) in both light and dark mode.
If the logo asset fails to load for any reason, a readable text fallback (e.g., “GrowInLove”) is still displayed without layout breakage.
Brand block alignment does not cause excessive header height on mobile (no large empty top padding).

file_operations.description: Make LandingBrand resilient: add image onError handling with a text-only fallback, ensure alt text remains, and introduce layout variants (e.g., compact row layout for header/footer) to keep alignment consistent and prevent extra header height on mobile.
Update header/footer usage of LandingBrand to use the compact/aligned variant and adjust header container spacing so the brand block doesn't inflate vertical height on mobile.

requirements.summary: Reduce excessive vertical whitespace across landing sections on mobile while keeping readability and avoiding overflow.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile viewport widths, there is no large blank vertical gap between header/hero and subsequent sections (as seen in the uploaded screenshots).
Section paddings/margins are consistently smaller on mobile than desktop, without crowding text or clipping content.
No horizontal overflow is introduced; page does not jitter/scroll sideways.

file_operations.description: Tighten section paddings/margins with mobile-first values (hero, benefit trio, carousel, story, privacy, features, CTA, footer). Ensure consistent spacing scale, remove any unintentional large gaps, and verify container padding doesn't cause horizontal overflow.

requirements.summary: Improve hero showcase and carousel screenshot fitting to prevent noticeable cropping and preserve aspect ratio.
acceptanceCriteria: In LandingHeroScreenshotShowcase and LandingScreenshotCarousel, screenshots are not noticeably cropped at the edges; key UI elements (top/bottom bars and main text) remain visible on typical mobile sizes.
Screenshot images preserve aspect ratio and do not appear stretched.
The phone mockup containers remain centered and visually balanced on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Adjust screenshot rendering inside the phone mockup to preserve full UI (prefer object-contain over object-cover, add a suitable background behind the image to avoid letterboxing looking broken), and keep the mockup centered/balanced across breakpoints.
Update carousel phone mockup image styles to avoid cropping (prefer object-contain), ensure aspect ratio is preserved, and keep the phone container centered while maintaining smooth transitions.

requirements.summary: Add accessible Our Story preview truncation with Read more/Read less expand-collapse behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: By default, “Our Story” shows a truncated preview (e.g., first 1–3 paragraphs) with a “Read more” control.
Clicking “Read more” expands to show the full story and changes to “Read less”; clicking “Read less” collapses back.
The expand/collapse behavior is accessible (keyboard operable) and does not cause layout overlap with adjacent sections.

file_operations.description: Create a landing-only Our Story component that renders a truncated preview by default with an accessible toggle control (button) for Read more/Read less, using founderStory paragraphs and avoiding layout overlap.
Replace the inline Our Story paragraph mapping with LandingOurStory and ensure spacing around the section remains tidy after expansion/collapse.

requirements.summary: Polish Explore the features accordion behavior (state cues, compact mobile spacing, stable open/close).
acceptanceCriteria: Collapsible rows clearly indicate open/closed state (e.g., chevron rotates or equivalent).
Section spacing is compact enough on mobile (no oversized gaps between collapsibles).
Opening/closing items does not cause content to jump unexpectedly or overflow its container.

file_operations.description: Refine the Explore the features accordion: control open state (single-open or explicit per-item state), rotate the chevron based on open/closed state, and reduce mobile padding/gaps for a compact layout. Use the existing shadcn-ui Collapsible component to provide the accordion behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fix footer layout/branding issues on mobile and implement a working Contact action with a mailto link.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer content is neatly stacked on mobile (no cramped overlaps; no excessive whitespace).
Footer brand/logo renders correctly and does not appear broken.
Clicking “Contact” reveals contact information that includes a functional mailto link (using a clearly-defined contact email constant in code if needed).

file_operations.description: Add a small landing-only contact constant (e.g., CONTACT_EMAIL) to keep the mailto address defined in one place.

Update Contact dialog content to include explicit contact information with a functional mailto link built from the shared email constant, while keeping copy in English. Use the existing shadcn-ui Dialog component; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Tidy footer stacking/spacing on mobile, ensure brand usage is not duplicated/misaligned, and keep Contact button wired to the updated dialog content.

requirements.summary: Keep the changeset small and landing-only with no backend changes, no UI library edits, and no unrelated dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Only landing-related files/components are modified for this change set (Landing page and its landing components/styles as needed).
No backend changes are introduced.
Build succeeds without introducing new dependencies unrelated to the landing UI.

file_operations.description: Limit edits in this changeset to landing section spacing, accordion polish, and wiring in the new landing-only components/content. Do not touch unrelated pages.
Constrain logo/alignment fixes to this landing-only brand component (no global or unrelated brand changes).
Keep screenshot-fit adjustments scoped to the landing hero showcase only.
Keep screenshot-fit adjustments scoped to the landing carousel only.
Keep dialog edits scoped to landing footer link content only.
Add only the minimal landing-specific component needed for Our Story truncation/toggle to reduce deployment risk.
Add a minimal landing-scoped contact constant used only by the landing footer dialog.
